newsitem.title: USA: Two offer to buy mass suicide mansion, level it.
newsitem.headline: Two offer to buy mass suicide mansion, level it.

text.p: Two businessmen have expressed interest in buying the $1.6-million mansion where 39 cult members committed suicide and tearing it down "to bring closure to the whole negative event," a realtor said on Monday.
Robert Dyson, owner of Dyson and Dyson Real Estate, said he brought the two parties together because they had similar intentions for the mansion in the posh Rancho Santa Fe suburb of San Diego.
"We're waiting to see what they will do," he said. While no firm offers have been made, "part of the discussion was possibly tearing down this house and starting over again."

Dyson said he anticipated things "getting back to normal" in the community, "if we can bring closure to this thing more quickly." The bodies were discovered last Wednesday but the county medical examiner said he believed the members died in batches, possibly starting as early as the previous Saturday.
